svg.title: All these inequalities use finite sums at each i. The original small activity and scalar bounds first give di ≤1/4 uniformly: for the scalar part apply the finite scalar-flow identity and the coarse individual correction bounds; for the activity part add the two individual norm bounds. Let D = supi di, which is therefore finite and nonnegative. The one-step activity inequality yields ∥Xi −X′ i∥≤8γ0D. The scalar identity and correction inequality yield bi|fi −f′ i| ≤4D X j<i sj ≤4γ0Dbi.
